page_annotations: The upper half of the page is blank apart from the folio number; entries occupy roughly y 1480–2240, plus one pencil line near y 3750.
Faint parenthesis-like marks near x≈2440, y≈1880 are probably offset and are not transcribed.

unresolved_relationships: On fol. 329 (source order 657), entries e 204(2), e 199, d.1021(1) and d.1013(2) are bracketed with 'See opp. page' and struck through. This suggests the entries on this page replace them; that relationship is probable, not confirmed.

coverage.finding: The pencil folio number '328' with superscript 'b' and a following stop is at the top left. It is represented correctly.

The two-line entry is represented. The double underline under the 7 of 1537 is noted. The ending of the right-hand line, '18:D' or '18.)', has a closing parenthesis-like stroke. The candidate correctly treats this as uncertain.
The interlinear ink note above the bracketed clause reads 'said in Misrabandhu Vinod to have been'. Its attachment to b002 is reasonable.
The ditto entry for d.1021 (1) is represented, with the raised '&c.' noted.
The small note '(1021 (2) + (3)‸ not Hindi)' sits below the shelfmark with a caret. The relation of the caret to '&c.' remains uncertain.
The e 199 entry is grouped with its continuation line. The caret after 35 is recorded.
The continuation line and the curved arrow to the caret are recorded. The form of the bracketed '(i.e. pp. 8–38)' is not fully secure (see unresolved).
The source shows 'p.p. 19–37', which the candidate records correctly. 'Charan' appears without the underdot.
The entry is represented. The cancelled word visibly ends in '-i' ('Jyotiṣi'/'Jyotisi'), not '-a'.
The faint pencil bracketed gloss below b009 is represented.
The isolated pencil cross-reference 'd.998 (4) see opp. page.' in the lower page is represented.
Very faint figures lie between b008 and b009 (about x 1600–2080, y 2000). They may be erased pencil or offset. The reading is appropriately hedged.

This includes shelfmarks, 'See opp. page' brackets and arrows, 'See Bhāṣā Jyotiṣa', a left-pointing arrow, and a pencil stroke into the gutter at y≈3790. None of it is transcribed as a target record. The faint parenthesis-like marks near x≈2440, y≈1880 are probably offset and are noted only in page annotations.

region_review.top: Contains only the pencil folio number 328ᵇ; the rest of the top is blank ruled paper.
region_review.middle: The entries b002–b010 run from y about 1480 to 2240, and all are represented. The faint figures b901 lie between b008 and b009.
region_review.bottom: Contains only the pencil cross-reference b011 near y 3750. The bottom edge is otherwise blank apart from a corner crease.
region_review.left_margin: Contains the shelfmark column entries and the small note b005; nothing else was seen.
region_review.right_margin: Gutter-side marks belong to the facing fol. 329, apart from the possible offset parentheses.
region_review.interlinear: Contains b003 above b002, b005 below b004, b007 below b006 and b010 below b009, all represented. The caret after '35' and the arrow are recorded.
